title: City: maps & the real world
body: The big scale. I love playing with real-world data like maps, point clouds and GPS, and turning it into something you can actually walk through, be it a digital twin or location-based AR. That this works at all still feels a bit like magic.

title: Room: games, apps & toys
body: The human scale: the things people pick up and play with. Games, apps, websites, buttons and sliders. This is where I get to prototype fast, from a tiny mobile game to a training sim to a whole UX overhaul. If it makes someone smile or learn something, I did my job.

title: Chip: tools & the nerdy bits
body: The smallest scale, and the one that makes everything else easier: tools, computer vision, AI and the work nobody sees. SDKs, synthetic training data, NPCs you can talk to, a simple but solid backend. The plumbing, basically. Nobody frames a photo of the plumbing, but try living without it.
